rules.chain_policy: ROUTED only; deterministic first chain from the frozen P16 grammar. GLOBAL_G2 is excluded from confirmatory vote.
rules.engines: Only engines active in the frozen fresh pair qualification.
rules.carrier: A fresh engine×world×family cell is eligible iff at least one BASE exact event in TARGET/SUBSET/SHAM × A/B matches one of the seven presealed Q0 positive keys for that family.
rules.baseline_support: May be true or false; the prospective endpoint is whether class and frozen-fiber interventions agree in support-change direction.
rules.duplicate_vote: At most one ROUTED chain per fresh world. Each engine×world×family contributes one cell.

endpoint.fiber_recovery: FROZEN_Q0 support equals FULL_CLASS and differs from BASE.
endpoint.pass: At least one fresh recovery in each P19 obstruction family (SF/B and B/E), across both source ecologies collectively, with no Q0-key refit.
endpoint.partial: Fresh recovery exists but only one obstruction family or one source ecology carries it.
endpoint.fail: Class effects occur on fresh carriers but frozen Q0 fibers recover none.
endpoint.hold: Carrier or fresh class-effect support is insufficient.
